name: Talkback
description: Hear your coding agents talk back. Forwards workspace focus and agent status to the local orca-talkback daemon, which speaks a short summary of each finished reply.

cover.alt: Talkback for Orca: hear your coding agents talk back. A short spoken summary of every finished reply, voiced locally on your Mac.

screenshots.alt: Diagram of how the Talkback plugin, the Claude Code hook and the local orca-talkback daemon fit together.
screenshots.caption: The plugin tells the local daemon what is on screen and when agents finish.

screenshots.alt: Bar chart: the first spoken word arrives about 0.8 seconds after the agent finishes.
screenshots.caption: The first word in under a second, all on device.

screenshots.alt: Line chart: echo cancellation makes the agent's own voice a median 26 dB quieter at the microphone.
screenshots.caption: Talk over it to stop it: its own voice is cancelled.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Click to mute the workspace on screen.
